prompt:
Build a physical hydraulically actuated backhoe mounted on a fixed base. The mechanism must coordinate five controlled axes: a base swivel motion and the articulated arm, linkage, and bucket motions needed to execute a digging trajectory. Each controlled motion must be produced through a real mechanical linkage and hydraulic-cylinder actuation path; do not prescribe the measured joint angles or bucket motion directly.

Read trajectory_scale and joint_reference_bias_deg from the MATLAB base workspace. Support trajectory_scale from 0.98 to 1.02. joint_reference_bias_deg may be either a scalar or a five-element vector bounded by -0.1 to 0.1 degrees per joint. Use these inputs to change the commanded coordinated joint trajectory while retaining a closed-loop physical motion system.

The controller must use actual joint-motion feedback to track the commanded trajectory, including coordinated reversals. The hydraulic command must drive the physical actuators, which in turn move the multibody mechanism. The system must remain finite and recover to the commanded trajectory after bounded reference changes.

Log complete-run MATLAB Timeseries named joint_reference, joint_state, and hydraulic_command. Each has 5 channels in bucket, upper arm, lower arm, base, and support order. joint_reference contains the five reference angles in deg; joint_state contains the five measured joint angles in deg; and hydraulic_command contains the five actuator pressure-command channels in the same axis order.

Save the completed model as cand_XMECH09.slx in the submission directory.

Submission filename contract: create, edit, and save the final self-contained Simulink model as cand_XMECH09.slx in the assigned submission directory; keep the latest usable state at that exact path throughout the run.
